summary: Phase 1 First Unit foundation tested end-to-end. Backend: 21/21 pytest cases pass covering auth (register/login/logout/me/refresh), verified-only gate (401 unauth, 403 unverified, 200 approved on /marketplace/summary and /members), admin routes (list users, RBAC), approval flow with VerificationEvent logging, password reset (no enumeration + invalid token 400), and verification record shape (no raw credential docs). Frontend E2E via Playwright: landing renders (navy/red, Oswald/Inter, Verified badge, avatar-ring); register lands on /verification with status label; admin login lands on /admin with user table; per-row status select updates verification_status; newly-approved member login lands on /marketplace with empty-state shell. httpOnly cookies working across origins.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS: allow_origins hardcodes localhost:3000 alongside FRONTEND_URL; fine for dev but consider driving fully from env for prod.
seed_admins updates existing admin password on env change but does not lower-case admin email consistently before find; currently ok since env values are lowercase.
verification/me returns record with all Mongo fields (id/user_id/current_state/provider/provider_reference/outcome/timestamps) - meets constraint 2 (no raw credential docs).
seed_data_creation: Test registers ephemeral test_<uuid>@example.com members; no cleanup required as they are inert.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_first_unit.py covers all Phase 1 endpoints. Playwright script exercises register -> verification -> admin approve -> marketplace flow using existing data-testids. The verified-only gate is enforced server-side (verified via 401 vs 403 status codes).
